content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, code AS 编码, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在集镇厂中按设计规模降序取第一条，得到规模最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "直接在设备台账中统计鼓风机类型设备总数，并按状态统计备用台数。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%'", "explanation": "从 plant 表按名称关键字匹配南郑中心污水处理厂，返回其设计处理规模及基本信息。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, code AS 厂站编码, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从厂站基本信息表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站，列出名称、编码、类型和设计规模。"}
{"sql": "SELECT kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(rated_kw)::numeric, 2) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量与额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.status AS 状态
FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%'
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "按厂站名称关键字匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码与类型。"}

{"sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT max(rated_kw) AS mx FROM device) SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kw, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id CROSS JOIN m WHERE d.rated_kw = m.mx ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "先取设备台账中最大额定功率，再列出所有功率等于该值的设备及其厂站信息"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 全区设计总规模_m3_d, count(*) AS 厂站数 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计规模求和，并统计厂站数量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 采样时间, r.inflow_m3h AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站编码 P01（南郑中心污水处理厂）取 plant_reading 中最新一条采样记录，返回其进水瞬时流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 采样时间, r.current_a AS 电流_A, r.running AS 运行状态 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从设备监测表中取 P01 厂 1 号鼓风机最新一条采样，返回实际采样时间与电流值（保留原值）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 采样时间,
       r.do_aerobic_1 AS 好氧区1号DO_mgL, r.do_aerobic_2 AS 好氧区2号DO_mgL
FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "从原始读数表按厂站取最近30分钟内最新一条采样的好氧区1号、2号溶解氧，各指标单独成列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 采样时间, r.mlss AS 污泥浓度MLSS_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配协税镇，从原始读数表取该厂最新一条采样的MLSS值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天（前一自然日）全部厂站小时处理水量得到全区总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.plant_id) r.plant_id, r.ts, r.tn_out FROM plant_reading r WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '1 hour' ORDER BY r.plant_id, r.ts DESC) SELECT p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, l.tn_out AS 出水总氮_mgL, l.ts AS 采样时间 FROM latest l JOIN plant p ON p.id = l.plant_id ORDER BY l.tn_out DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取最近1小时内各厂站最新一条原始出水总氮读数，按总氮降序取最高的一座厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(pr.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh
FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%'
  AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "以中心厂昨日 0 点至今日 0 点的小时表鼓风机功率求和，得到昨日总耗电量（kWh）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总本周以来（自本周一零点起）小时表进水量，得到各厂累计处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD均值_mgL, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值_mgL, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值_mgL, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%南郑中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.code, p.name, date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date", "explanation": "用小时均值表筛选昨天（前一个自然日）中心厂数据，对各出水指标求全天平均作为日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.code, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "从小时均值表按厂站统计过去24小时进水氨氮平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date) AS 有数据天数, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 期间处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h)/6)::numeric) AS 平均每天处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "按梁山镇厂站在10月30日至11月4日（6个自然日）汇总小时处理水量，并除以6得到平均日处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())", "explanation": "汇总本周（周一至今）所有厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天（前一自然日）全部厂站的小时鼓风机功率（即耗电量 kWh）与处理水量，两者相除得吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD平均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取中心厂(P01)今天0点至当前(12点，即上午)的小时均值表，对进水COD(cod_in)求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT max(temp_c) AS 最高气温_摄氏度, min(temp_c) AS 最低气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选昨天全天（2026-11-04）的气象原始读数，并统计最高、最低气温。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 2) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL
FROM plant_reading r
JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id","explanation":"小时聚合表不含 MLSS，因此用原始读数表统计过去7天各厂 MLSS 的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.code AS 厂站编码, p.name AS 厂站, avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric(10,1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now() - interval '1 day') AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.code, p.name", "explanation": "在小时聚合表中筛选中心厂昨天整点数据，对曝气总风量取平均，得到全天平均曝气风量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按整点分组汇总今天全区所有厂站的小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08'
  AND h.hour <  timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'
ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "在小时聚合表中按厂站名称匹配协税镇，筛选11月3日整日各整点，输出出水总磷小时均值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_摄氏度
FROM weather
WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1","explanation":"按东八区自然日筛选11月1日至4日的气象原始数据，并计算每日平均气温。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 平均出水COD_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1","explanation":"统计过去7天各厂小时均值表中的出水COD平均值，按均值降序取最高厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY 1, p.name ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂本周小时表，用鼓风机耗电量除以处理水量得到每日吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按昨天整日汇总各厂站小时处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)），降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "按厂汇总过去7天碳源投加总量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "本周小时均值表按厂站汇总鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，相除得吨水电耗，升序取最低两座厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按自然日汇总过去7天全区小时处理水量，取水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取最高的一条，返回厂站、时间和COD值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高氨氮
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按小时聚合表统计最近7天内出水氨氮小时最大值超过5 mg/L的厂站及其超标小时数与峰值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "按本周起点筛选小时均值表，统计所有厂站出水总磷小时最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时总数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, max(h.nh3n_out_max) AS 最高氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "查黄官镇11月4日的小时数据，按小时出水氨氮最大值统计超标小时数并取当日峰值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水总氮_mgL, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值_mgL, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "从小时均值表筛选中心厂最近7天数据，tn_out 小时均值直接取平均与最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 出水不达标小时数, count(h.hour) AS 有效监测小时数 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以全部厂站为主表左连接昨天的小时均值数据，按演示阈值统计任一项出水指标（COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷、SS）超标的小时数，没有数据的厂显示 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 首次超标时间, h.tp_out_max AS 出水总磷最大值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour <= now() AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选协税镇本周内小时出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的最早记录。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, p.code AS 厂站编码, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表返回所属厂站名称与编码。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_℃
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.running AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂鼓风机在过去24小时内的运行读数，按设备编码分组求平均轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 采样时间, r.vibration_mms AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.vibration_mms DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查询最近7天所有鼓风机的振动读数，按振动值降序取最大值及对应设备和采样时间。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流_A
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE d.kind = '提升泵' AND p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.running
  AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name, d.code
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵在昨天自然日内运行（running=true）的原始读数，按设备分组求平均电流。"}

{"sql":"SELECT count(*) AS 停机分钟数
FROM device_reading dr
JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
  AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1'
  AND dr.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'
  AND dr.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'
  AND dr.running = false;","explanation":"按黄官镇1号鼓风机 P06-BL-1 筛选11月4日全天原始分钟级设备读数，统计 running=false 的条数即为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql":"SELECT dr.ts AS 时间, dr.vibration_mms AS 振动_mm_s
FROM device_reading dr
JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id
WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1'
  AND dr.ts >= '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'
  AND dr.ts < '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'
  AND dr.vibration_mms > 7.1
ORDER BY dr.ts
LIMIT 1","explanation":"查询黄官镇污水处理站1号鼓风机在11月4日当天振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的原始采样时间及振动值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.running) AS 运行分钟
FROM device_reading dr
JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵'
  AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, d.id, d.code
ORDER BY p.id, d.code","explanation":"筛选昨天各厂污泥泵的设备分钟级监测记录，按厂站和设备统计 running=true 的分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT ts AS 时间, rain_mm_h AS 降雨强度_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在原始气象表中筛选10月31日当天的所有采样，按降雨强度降序取最大值及其发生时间。"}

{"sql": "WITH daily AS (
  SELECT (h.hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS 日期,
         sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE p.code = 'P03'
    AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'
    AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT round((
  max(CASE WHEN 日期 = DATE '2026-10-31' THEN 水量 END) -
  max(CASE WHEN 日期 = DATE '2026-10-30' THEN 水量 END)
)::numeric, 0) AS 比前一天增加水量_m3
FROM daily;", "explanation": "统计梁山镇P03在10月30日和10月31日的小时处理水量日合计，并计算10月31日比前一天增加的水量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 采样时间, r.do_aerobic_1 AS 好氧区溶解氧_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND r.ts < '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08' AND r.do_aerobic_1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.do_aerobic_1 ASC, r.ts ASC LIMIT 1","explanation":"查询黄官镇厂11月4日15:00至18:00原始采样中的好氧区溶解氧，按数值升序取最低值及其实际采样时间。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' THEN '昨天' ELSE '前天' END AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1) SELECT round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 昨天处理水量_m3, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 前天处理水量_m3, round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = '昨天' THEN 水量 END) - max(CASE WHEN 日期 = '前天' THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 多处理水量_m3 FROM d", "explanation": "按小时聚合表分别汇总昨天与前天的全区处理水量，并计算差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高出水总磷_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now() - interval '2 days')
  AND h.hour <  date_trunc('day', now() - interval '1 day')", "explanation": "按小时聚合表取协税镇 11月3日全天出水总磷小时最大值中的最大值。"}

{"sql":"WITH max_rain_day AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS day
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND ts <= now()
  ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.day AS 日期,
       round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 全区处理水量_m3
FROM max_rain_day m
JOIN plant_reading_1h h
  ON h.hour >= m.day
 AND h.hour < m.day + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY m.day","explanation":"先在过去7天原始气象数据中按最大降雨强度定位日期，再汇总该自然日全区小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高出水总磷_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now() - interval '2 days')
  AND h.hour <  date_trunc('day', now() - interval '1 day')
GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "按小时聚合表统计协税镇 11月3日全天出水总磷小时最大值的最大值，并按厂站分组。"}

{"sql":"WITH rain AS (
  SELECT ts,
         ts - (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts) * interval '1 hour') AS grp
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08'
    AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
    AND rain_mm_h > 0
)
SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间,
       max(ts) AS 结束时间,
       count(*) AS 降雨读数小时数
FROM rain
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY 开始时间;","explanation":"查询10月31日降雨强度大于0的连续时段，按小时连续性分组后得到每段降雨的开始和结束时间。"}

{"sql": "WITH per_plant AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod
  FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT pp.name AS 厂站, round(pp.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD, round(o.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均进水COD
FROM per_plant pp CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE pp.avg_cod > o.avg_cod
ORDER BY pp.avg_cod DESC", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天小时表进水COD均值，并与全区整体均值比较，筛出高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂')::numeric) AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 全区处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric * 100, 2) AS 占比_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "按小时表汇总最近7天全区及中心厂处理水量，再求中心厂占全区比值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 2) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.tn_in IS NOT NULL AND h.tn_in > 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站统计过去7天小时均值的进出水总氮浓度，用 1-出水/进水 计算总氮去除率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_pct FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "汇总昨天各厂小时处理水量后除以设计规模，得到负荷率百分比。"}
